title: Unsigned Trade Visa
summary: Gerringothe must have this document to issue the Signed Trade Visa.

fields.Trade Visa: Leave it in Gerringothe Thorm’s inventory and resolve the toll dialogue by giving her all carried party gold, at least 5,000 gp. She grants the separate Signed Trade Visa, a one-use Flesh to Gold scroll that cannot be transcribed.
fields.Acquisition: Carried by Gerringothe at the Reithwin Tollhouse. Looting it before paying removes the prerequisite.

changes: Added reviewed native BG3 gameplay and exact item and dependency citations.
